svg.title: TYPE_REPARK_TRAY / TYPE_MOVE_TRAY -> PlanReparkTrayJob()
svg.desc: Move one tray to a parking node. Two jobs move the same tray, so rule A chains them. Six other job methods create their tray moves through this method.
